# MyHealth@EU / Electronic Cross-Border Health Services — Cached Snapshot

Source: https://health.ec.europa.eu/ehealth-digital-health-and-care/electronic-cross-border-health-services_en
Snapshot date: 2026-08-19

## Overview

The **eHealth Digital Service Infrastructure (eHDSI)** ensures continuity of care for European citizens travelling within the EU, letting EU countries exchange health data securely, efficiently, and interoperably. Citizens recognise the availability of these services under the brand **"MyHealth@EU"**.

## Services currently being introduced in all EU countries

- **ePrescription and eDispensation** — allows EU citizens to obtain medication in a pharmacy in another EU country via online transfer of their electronic prescription from their country of affiliation to their country of travel.
- **Patient Summaries** — provide key health information (allergies, current medication, previous illnesses, surgeries, etc.), part of the larger electronic Health Record, giving doctors essential information in their own language when treating a patient from another EU country.

In the long term, **medical images, lab results, and hospital discharge reports** will also be available across the EU, with the full health record to follow. Exchange of ePrescriptions and Patient Summaries is open to all EU countries; many EU/EEA countries are implementing these services.

## Governance and financing

- Through **core services**, the European Commission provides common ICT infrastructure and cross-cutting services (terminology, interoperability, etc.).
- EU countries set up **generic services** connecting national eHealth systems through **National Contact Points for eHealth (NCPeH)**, funded via the Connecting Europe Facility Telecom Programme (2015–2020) and the EU4Health Programme (2021–2027).
- The **eHealth EU countries Expert Group (eHMSEG)** comprises managers responsible for NCPeH implementation.
- The **eHealth Operational Management Board (eHOMB)** oversees service provision and takes tactical/operational decisions on eHDSI.

## Related instruments

- Cross-border healthcare Directive 2011/24/EU.
- eHDSI Requirements Catalogue and Interoperability Specifications.
